short_description: Compare estimated website traffic and acquisition signals.
description: Analyze estimated website visits, engagement, rankings, channel mix, and geographic distribution with dynamically discovered SandBase capabilities.

requires: SandBase MCP connection or SANDBASE_API_KEY for live data

install.prompt: Use $similarweb-analytics to compare these domains with current SandBase traffic data.
install.cli: npx skills add sandbaseai/sandbase-skills --skill similarweb-analytics --agent codex
install.global_cli: npx skills add sandbaseai/sandbase-skills --skill similarweb-analytics --agent codex --global

examples: Compare monthly traffic and engagement for these three competitor domains.
Explain which acquisition channels appear to be driving this site's growth.
Create a six-month traffic, ranking, and country-mix snapshot for example.com.

required.label: SandBase MCP connection or API key

notes: Supports the official SandBase MCP bridge and documented Bearer-authenticated REST API.
Discovers and inspects live capabilities instead of preserving Manus runtime code or frozen Similarweb parameters.
Third-party traffic estimates are not equivalent to first-party analytics.
Never duplicates a pending asynchronous run.

endpoints.summary: Discover current website-traffic and engagement capabilities.
Inspect live schemas, coverage, pricing, and execution requirements.
Execute an approved traffic or audience-data capability.
Recover recent run status and recorded cost.
Check balance before a paid multi-domain batch.
